title: LRU cache as a bookcase
label: Low bookcase on turned legs with ten slots, A to J: A and C at left, F in the middle, H, I and J at right. On top, between bookends, the four held books E, B, G and D stand most recent at left; D, next out, is outlined.
caption: Using a book moves it to the left end of the top shelf; on a miss the right-hand book, the least recently used, drops back into its own slot below to make room.
